title: Dashboards: add quant perf panels (quant_mode/kernel/model_family) + link benchmark lab runbook
author: Aisha Bello
pr_body: Context: As part of the FP8/INT8 kernel benchmarking sprint, we need first-class dashboard visibility into quantized paths across the dimensions we keep debating in threads (quant mode, chosen kernel, model family) and a clear pointer to the benchmark-lab execution runbook so anyone can reproduce. This PR updates the Quant Perf Grafana dashboard in observability-pack, adds templating variables + panels, and standardizes legend + tag conventions to match the structured perf events being emitted by the runtime/benchmark harness. Changes: (1) Dashboard templating variables: quant_mode (fp16|fp8|int8), model_family (llama|qwen|mistral|other), gpu_sku (a100|h100|h200|l40s), runtime_version, kernel_family, kernel_id (optional; disabled by default to avoid accidental high-cardinality). (2) New panels: TTFT p50/p95 by quant_mode; TPOT p50/p95 by quant_mode; tokens/sec (decode) split by quant_mode and gpu_sku; prefill vs decode phase breakdown (stacked area) filtered by model_family; kernel selection distribution (top-N kernel_family + other) for prefill and decode; queue_wait_ms p95 split by quant_mode (requires scheduler instrumentation); error rate + fallback rate panels to catch silent degradations when auto-selector drops to fp16; a small table panel that links a selected run_id to the benchmark artifact location (when present). (3) Runbook link: adds a prominent dashboard annotation + panel description link to the benchmark-lab runbook (Confluence: eng-serving-runtime/benchmarking-and-perf-suite/runbook-running-benchmarks-in-benchmark-lab) and notes on required tags for plots to populate. (4) Alerting notes (non-enforced): adds suggested alert queries/threshold placeholders for quant-perf regressions (these are intentionally not wired to Alertmanager in this PR; that is tracked in ENG-24817). Implementation notes: We keep kernel_id as an opt-in variable because full kernel_id in legends can explode cardinality; default views aggregate by kernel_family and only show top 10 by count. All panels use runtime_version + gpu_sku + model_family as primary splitters to keep comparisons apples-to-apples. The dashboard assumes the metrics/events include: quant_mode, model_name, model_family, gpu_sku, runtime_version, phase (prefill|decode), kernel_family, kernel_id (optional), and queue_wait_ms histograms. Files / areas changed: dashboards/quant_perf_dashboard.jsonnet (new panels + vars), dashboards/lib/templating.libsonnet (helpers for quant vars), dashboards/README.md (add quant dashboard section + how to use), dashboards/links.libsonnet (runbook link), dashboards/examples/quant_perf_dashboard_screenshot.png (updated), and small updates to metric naming docs to match tags. Testing: jsonnet render + grafana dashboard linter, local import into staging Grafana; spot-checked queries against last 7d perf-canary data (H100) and a benchmark-lab run (A100). Rollout: dashboard-only change; safe to merge. Follow-ups: (a) wire alerts + routing to #eng-runtime once regression thresholds are finalized (ENG-24817), (b) confirm final tag key names after runtime spans land (redwood PR 10621/10631).
